messages.author: c9416b6005bf4eb7
messages.subject: R-GSOC-24
parts:
Dear R GSOC community,
Google has announced the timeline for GSOC 24, and so I have set up a new repo/wiki for R project. https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2024/wiki -- Mentors: please add your project ideas to that page. If your project was not funded/successful last year, it is ok to re-post it again this year.
Admins: We will need to submit an org app for R before the Feb 6 deadline.
Best,
Toby

messages.author: c9416b6005bf4eb7
messages.subject: Re: R-GSOC-24
parts:
Hi again! Today the GSOC org application period starts. https://opensource.googleblog.com/2023/11/google-summer-of-code-2024-celebrating-20th-year.html
Vijay I believe you did the application last year, so could you please do it again this year?
If not please tell us right away so we can organize.
Thanks
Toby

messages.author: 32a1634124122d59
messages.subject: R-GSOC 2024 application: Need support from memtors to list projects
parts:
Dear GSOC Mentors,

Google OSPO is reviewing applications for 2024. We have only a few projects lists on the projects page right now. I would like to request all the mentors to please list potential projects soon, to make our application stronger.

Thanks and regards,

Vijay


--
---
Vijay Barve
GSoC :R Project Org Admin
https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/
---
